notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); no hardware and no upstream simulator or Isaac Gym run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's helper PythonObjectDriver / family python-object is not used. X1DHStandEnv is not a Gymnasium environment: it has no action_space or observation_space, its reset() takes no seed and returns (obs, privileged_obs) (humanoid/envs/base/legged_robot.py:157-162), and step(actions) takes a (num_envs, num_actions) tensor and returns (obs_buf, privileged_obs_buf, rew_buf, reset_buf, extras) (legged_robot.py:111-155). The config-only PythonObjectDriver command map cannot express the ticks loop, the 12-value action batch or the 5-tuple conversion, so the package is a direct Driver over the upstream class with a package fake; the card's direct-driver decision is retained. Only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are bound. cap.world.seed.v1 is deliberately not bound: the environment has no integer seed input, reset takes no seed and it exposes no get_state/set_state. The required reset seed output is 0 and only an empty options object is accepted (the upstream reset takes none). The step action is 12 values, the shipped X1DHStandCfg num_actions (x1_dh_stand_config.py:49); its envelope is -100..100 from X1DHStandCfg.normalization.clip_actions (x1_dh_stand_config.py:367), which the upstream applies with torch.clip(actions, -clip_actions, clip_actions) (legged_robot.py:117-118). The only gate warning is G4.REF_VALUE: the cited line shows clip_actions = 100. but no line of the clone writes -100, so the negative endpoint cannot be shown literally; the code negates the positive value at legged_robot.py:118. No other warning. The fake is a pure-Python stand-in, not a recording and not the upstream simulator: it has no rigid bodies, contacts, terrain, PD controller, domain randomization, command sampler, reward terms or upstream termination rules, and its values are placeholders. It returns full-size observation arrays (3102 = 66*47 and 219 = 3*73) but fills them from a 12-joint stand-in, so the layout and values are not the upstream observation; one environment is served, not the 4096 of the training config (x1_dh_stand_config.py:50); each policy step is 10 ms (dt 0.001 s times decimation 10, x1_dh_stand_config.py:153-158). No native.py or hardware/sim backend exists: the real path would need Isaac Gym, torch and a GPU (x1_dh_stand_env.py:35-40; setup.py:44-50) plus a factory/adapter that was not written or run, so deployment construction is not validated. No catalogue requests: both capabilities are catalogue classes. check-report.json is regenerated by each gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review corrected driver.py fact scope, replaced the warning-producing action bound with operator_required limits, added cancellation and state caching per completed tick, refused non-finite native scalars before boolean conversion, and disclosed the missing live tensor adapter and upstream process hazards. Corrected terminal reward preservation in fake.py, extended test_driver.py, added site-limits.example.json, synchronized facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. All G1-G9 checks pass without provenance warnings; strict collection reports only RESULT_DIGEST_STALE because the author RESULT.json is intentionally unchanged, and the orchestrator must apply the new stable digest. This is an accepted fake-only R0 contract with evidence contract_checked, not a live Isaac Gym or hardware route. For the human reviewer: No live backend is enabled, consistent with the brief's fake-only-contract policy. The adapter passes Python lists while LeggedRobot.step requires device-resident torch tensors; a live factory must supply tensor conversion and single-environment configuration. Construction acquires Isaac Gym, changes process-wide torch JIT flags and creates a simulator/viewer; viewer close or QUIT can call sys.exit and rendering can block in fetch_results or sync_frame_time. Observation sizes are preserved but layouts, rewards and dynamics remain placeholders. The clip is not a physical joint/torque envelope; the example overlay is fake-scale only. Refresh RESULT.json from check-report.json via the orchestrator; no signature, hardware run or simulator run is claimed.
